newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark to invest 600 mln Dkk by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark to invest 600 mln Dkk by 2000.

text.p: Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark said on Wednesday that it would invest 600 million crowns in a new mobile telephone system by the year 2000.
The majority state-owned former monopoly was one of four succesful bidders for licences awarded on Wednesday to operate new DCS 1800 systems.

Tele Danmark Mobil Managing Director Joergen Bang-Jensen told a news conference that his goal was geographical cover of 50 percent of the new system within two years. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969653
